_label: G027 + G032 / S010 §2 §8 §11. Complete byte anatomy of the NX -- the parts SUM TO THE ACTUAL FILE with zero unaccounted bytes -- and what transfers to the next specimen.
_evidence: MEASURED from the artifact's own manifest and byte extents; the reconciliation is exact.

reconciliation.note: 0 unaccounted. An anatomy whose parts do not sum to the file is not an anatomy.

WHY_EACH_SURVIVING_BYTE_EXISTS.codes: 426.3 MiB, 92.3% of the artifact -- the representation itself at 6 bits/weight over groups of 64. This is the only part a better representation class could attack.
WHY_EACH_SURVIVING_BYTE_EXISTS.scales: 17.76 MiB, one fp16 per group. NOT removable: dropping to per-tensor scaling is exactly the uniform control, which measured 6,325,960x worse perplexity at 4 bits. This metadata is the cheapest thing in the artifact per unit of capability it buys.
WHY_EACH_SURVIVING_BYTE_EXISTS.zeros: 17.76 MiB, one fp16 per group. Asymmetric weight ranges need an offset; the symmetric-only variant is the same catastrophic control.
WHY_EACH_SURVIVING_BYTE_EXISTS.norms: 0.125 MiB, 65,536 params (0.011% of the model) kept raw fp16. Quantising them would save essentially nothing and they are disproportionately sensitive.
WHY_EACH_SURVIVING_BYTE_EXISTS.manifest: 0.041 MiB of tensor names, shapes, byte extents and the tie record. Without it the payload is unaddressable -- this is the difference between an artifact and a blob.

RANKED_BY_bytes_x_reducibility_x_leverag.reason: largest organ AND the least reducible -- spectrally within 1.32-1.69x of random, so structural classes cannot pay and only bit-width moves it, which collapses below 4 bits. The biggest pile of bytes is the one with the least to give.

q_proj carries the heaviest tail measured anywhere in this body (kurtosis 6.76 against the MLP's 3.7-4.0). Outlier-aware classes were tested ON THE MLP, where they failed for the measured reason that it has no outliers -- they were NEVER tested on the organ that actually has them. This is the clearest remaining experiment on this specimen.

the most structured organ (3.15x random) and the most tolerant of aggressive bit reduction, but low-rank on it was only NEUTRAL, and 2-bit embeddings impose a ~1.95x perplexity floor no matter what the other organs get.
7.7% of the artifact, and the measured cost of reducing it is catastrophic. Coarser groups were tested: g128 lowers EBPW to 4.250 but drops top-1 to 0.714. This metadata is load-bearing.

G032_WHAT_TRANSFERS_TO_THE_NEXT_SPECIMEN.pre_flight_diagnostic: compute top-k singular-value energy against a matched random Gaussian BEFORE choosing any representation class. Ratio <~2 predicts structural classes fail. Costs seconds and would have predicted both failures on this body before either was implemented.
G032_WHAT_TRANSFERS_TO_THE_NEXT_SPECIMEN.organ_ordering_rule: rank organs by MEASURED spectral structure and kurtosis, never by mass. On this body the largest organ was the least compressible and the most outlier-heavy organ was never tested.
G032_WHAT_TRANSFERS_TO_THE_NEXT_SPECIMEN.metadata_is_not_overhead: per-group scale+zero is 7.7% of the artifact and buys a ~6-million-fold perplexity difference against per-tensor scaling. Counting it as waste to be minimised is exactly backwards.
G032_WHAT_TRANSFERS_TO_THE_NEXT_SPECIMEN.at_rest_vs_in_flight: EBPW measures bytes at rest. Unless decode is FUSED into the accumulation loop, a smaller artifact reconstructs to the same dense working set and moves the same bytes per token. Measure the reconstruction blow-up before promising a physical win.
G032_WHAT_TRANSFERS_TO_THE_NEXT_SPECIMEN.kernel_before_bandwidth: on this machine's CPU path, matched-byte dtype swaps moved decode 1.47x, so byte reduction does not automatically become speed. Establish whether the path is bandwidth-bound BEFORE valuing a compression result in wall-time terms.
